vocab.example_ko: 우크라이나 드론 공격 의심 러시아 군함, 벵가지서 침몰

vocab.mean_en: subjected to official economic or political penalties
vocab.example: Ukraine sinks Russian warship Merkury off Libya, damages sanctioned Russian cargo ship

vocab.mean_en: a list of people or organizations viewed with suspicion
vocab.example: US adds Megaspeed, AI firm at center of Nvidia scandal, to trade blacklist
vocab.example_ko: 미국, 엔비디아 스캔들의 중심 AI 회사 메가스피드(Megaspeed)를 거래 블랙리스트에 추가

vocab.mean_en: to establish officially, such as a tax or penalty
vocab.example: Trump Administration Imposes Sanctions on Megaspeed, Singaporean Firm at Center of Nvidia Scandal

vocab.mean_en: discussions aimed at reaching an agreement
vocab.example: COP31 negotiations break down as countries fail to agree on climate deal
vocab.example_ko: 국가들이 기후 협약에 동의하지 않아 COP31 협상이 결렬되었습니다.

vocab.mean_en: comprehensive and extending over all or most things
vocab.example: UN COP31 climate talks collapse without an overarching deal as nations deadlock over fossil fuel commitments

vocab.mean_en: irritable and quarrelsome; difficult to control
vocab.example: Cop31 as it happened: EU and others reject deal as longest climate summit comes to fractious end

vocab.mean_en: restored to a previous position or status
vocab.example: Jensen Huang’s return as it happened: Nvidia gains nearly $1tn in value after co-founder reinstated
vocab.example_ko: Jensen Huang의 복귀: Nvidia는 공동 창립자가 복직한 후 거의 1조 달러의 가치를 얻습니다.
